name: VGMdb (Self-hosted)
overview: VGMdb metadata for music libraries, with a configurable API server.
description: Adds support for VGMdb to music libraries. The API server URL is configurable, so it can be pointed at a self-hosted vgmdb instance instead of the unreachable public one. Uses a distinct plugin id so it installs alongside the official VGMdb plugin rather than colliding with it.

versions.changelog: Configurable API server URL via the plugin settings page.
